visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with styled brown hair, wearing a black textured blazer over a black t-shirt, stands in the center of a studio environment. He begins speaking directly to the camera with expressive hand gestures and a focused facial expression. The background is a dimly lit, blurred room with shelves containing various books and decorative items, creating a professional vlog atmosphere. (2) Visual overlays appear on the screen, showing the red and white YouTube logo followed by the blue and white Facebook logo. The man continues to explain the topic, pointing towards the floating digital graphics. A red book titled "影音巨獸 YouTube" is held up by the man, its white and black text clearly visible against the solid red cover. (3) The scene shifts to stock footage showing a woman in a purple sweater looking at a large computer monitor displaying a landscape fire. It then cuts back to the man in the studio, then to a shot of three people in a modern office looking at documents together under bright indoor lights. (4) A comedic clip of Dwight Schrute from 'The Office' appears, where he is yelling with intense facial expressions. This is followed by a vintage-style Windows XP startup screen animation with its iconic logo and bright blue background. The man's commentary continues as an overlay at the bottom. (5) A close-up of a smartphone screen shows a finger scrolling through a Facebook mobile feed, displaying various photos and videos. Another close-up shows a thumb navigating a mobile interface, highlighting the user experience of social media apps. The man returns to the screen, gesturing emphatically with his hands. (6) Stock footage of a man looking stressed while holding a phone appears, followed by a man in bed yawning while looking at his screen. Large yellow text overlays "釣魚標題" and "內容空洞" appear on screen to emphasize his points. A funny clip of a cat quickly typing on a laptop follows. (7) A woman in professional attire is shown shouting in an office setting. The scene cuts to a top-down view of hands typing rapidly on a white mechanical keyboard on a wooden desk. Back in the studio, the man explains the algorithm change as yellow "觀看時數" text pops up. (8) Clips of a female influencer talking into a microphone with a ring light in the background are shown. Then, a male gamer with headphones is seen gaming in a dark room with purple neon lights. A clip of PewDiePie gaming with his signature headset is featured prominently. (9) The man concludes by holding the red book "影音巨獸 YouTube" once more, presenting it directly to the camera. The final shot is a graphic of the book cover over a black and white grid background with a yellow call-to-action button at the bottom.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male narrator speaking in a clear, high-pitched, and energetic tone. His speech rate is fast, characteristic of modern social media storytelling. Underneath his voice, an upbeat electronic pop track with a steady 4/4 beat and bright synthesizer textures plays at a moderate volume. (2) A sharp "whoosh" sound effect triggers as the YouTube logo appears, marking a distinct visual and audio transition. The narrator's pitch variability is high as he emphasizes the word "YouTube." The background music maintains its tempo, providing a rhythmic backdrop that complements the narrator's enthusiastic delivery style. (3) A subtle "click" sound is heard when the Facebook logo enters. The narrator maintains a professional narrative tone with high articulation clarity. The music's beat strength is moderate, featuring a light electronic percussion track. There is no audible ambient noise, suggesting a high-quality studio recording. (4) A comedic "shout" sound from Dwight's clip briefly interrupts, followed by the electronic chime of the Windows XP startup sound. These SFX are mixed clearly above the BGM but below the primary narrator's voice. The narrator's intensity increases slightly to match the dramatic visual content. (5) A "pop" sound effect occurs during a visual transition to the Facebook interface. The narrator explains the "surprising difference" in user behavior. The BGM remains consistent, but the narrator's arousal level is high, conveying excitement about the data findings he is presenting to the listeners. (6) A "ding" or bell-like SFX sounds when the "Algorithm" text appears. The narrator's speech becomes more measured to explain the technical details of view counts versus watch time. The music continues without pauses, keeping the energy level high throughout the explanation of the platform's crisis. (7) The sound of rapid mechanical keyboard typing is briefly layered into the mix as a person is shown working. The narrator's voice dominates the mid-range frequencies, while the BGM's low-end bass provides a foundation. A quick "whoosh" SFX transitions the scene back to the main presenter. (8) Game-related sounds like character jumps or UI clicks from PewDiePie's video are briefly heard, blended with the narrator's explanation of the influencer's rise. The narrator's tone shifts to one of respect and awe. The BGM's harmonic tension level remains low and stable. (9) A final "swish" sound marks the appearance of the book. The narrator delivers the call to action with a friendly and authoritative tone. The music swells slightly in volume as the speech concludes, ending the video with a professional, polished audio finish and a sense of completion.
